title: Missing EPIPE handling
detail: The original code handled errno.EPIPE by wrapping stdout and stderr to suppress broken pipe errors and exiting with code 1. The new code removes this special case, so a broken pipe will raise an unhandled OSError instead of exiting gracefully.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: Twisted's DeferredLock exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. This condition always evaluates to True, causing the lock to be acquired twice and potentially deadlocking.

title: Unawaited lock acquisition
detail: Calling `acquire()` returns a Deferred that must be awaited. Without awaiting, the lock may not be acquired before the next operation, leading to race conditions.
